scripts.build: npm --prefix ../shared run build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --external:firebase-admin --external:firebase-functions --outfile=lib/index.js && node scripts/prepare-deploy-package.mjs
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project helpinus-rules-test 'vitest run rules-tests'
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project helpinus-integration-test 'npm --prefix src/functions exec -- vitest run integration-tests'
